Beacon Pointe Advisors has announced its acquisition of Edge Wealth Management, a New York City–based investment advisory firm. Edge Wealth Management’s focus on fixed income and equity investing adds a distinct investment perspective alongside Beacon Pointe’s comprehensive allWEALTH framework. The transaction brings Beacon Pointe’s total assets under advisement to approximately $72 billion.

Fixed income and equity investing are central to Edge Wealth Management’s work with high-net-worth investors, institutions, family offices and young professionals. Established in 2006, the firm advises on approximately $905 million in client assets under management. The team brings an institutional and capital markets background and a focus on income generation, long-term growth and tax efficiency, complemented by Beacon Pointe’s investment research resources.
